excluded.reason: committed evidence documents are data, not code, and are validated by the deterministic gates that produced them; the harnesses that generate them are review-relevant and matched above
prose and acceptance data outside docs/adr; reviewed by people and by deterministic gates, not by the model
binary and vector assets carry no reviewable source. Property lists are deliberately NOT here: a macOS entitlements plist is a privilege boundary, so it is review-relevant above.
styling is gated by the SHA-pinned visual-proof and axe gates, not by model review
remaining prose, data, and configuration not named as review-relevant above; covered by deterministic gates

catch-all: every remaining path is deliberately outside model review. It is the last resort, not the routine answer — an executable or trust-boundary path landing here is a profile gap, not an exclusion. Inclusion wins over exclusion, and the relevant list is keyed by file type rather than directory on purpose; see docs/qa/keiko-for-quality.md.
